summary: Kevin Ward got turned around and cliffed out on steep cliffs on the Hwy 82 side of Red Bluffs outside Carbondale during a ~2 p.m. Thanksgiving-day hike; GCSAR (Tom Ice IC) notified ~4 p.m.; Classic Air Medical flyover; Kyle McAlpin rappelled down with food/water/clothing and Elise Wolf hoisted Ward ~200 ft in a harness; six-person team had him out after 2 a.m.; uninjured
responding_agency: Garfield County Search and Rescue; Classic Air Medical
notes: Run 753: resolves the run-733-parked Sopris Sun Thanksgiving teaser; date = Thanksgiving 2022 (Thu 2022-11-24, weekday-verified; follow-up KDNK interview 'this Thursday, Dec. 1' = 2022-12-01)
